shag.note: messy layered shag, side-swept fringe covers the character's RIGHT eye (screen left); teen / young adult

spikes.note: big spiky anime hair with a toon outline, fringe just above the eyes; sits high (short at the back); teens / young adults, action heroes

wolfcut.note: long layered wavy wolf cut, wispy fringe with the eyes showing through, falls onto the shoulders at the back; teens / young adults, any gender

sweep.note: thick layered hair with a heavy side-swept fringe over the character's right eye, ends at the jaw; teens / young adults

slickback.note: swept-back messy hair, face fully clear, longer layered strands at the back of the neck; teens / young adults, cool or rebellious types — takes any hairCol

slickbackdye.note: the same cut in its original colours: black with a purple-dyed underlayer at the ends (fixed colour, hairCol is ignored)

tousled.note: short messy spiky hair, pointed fringe above the eyes, sticks out at the sides; kids / teens / young adults, everyday or action

scruffy.note: full, scruffy, choppy hair with a jagged fringe touching the eyebrows, covers the whole back of the head; kids / teens / young adults

capcut.note: messy layered hair under a black distressed baseball cap (brim forward, chains on the back strap); the hair takes hairCol, the cap keeps its own colours; street / skater / cool teens

feathered.note: short feathered layered hair, side-swept fringe above the eyes, tapered at the nape; kids / teens / young adults, a neat everyday look

longsweep.note: long straight hair to the waist, centre part, side-swept fringe over the character's right eye, strands in front of the shoulders; teens / adults

shaggymullet.note: big shaggy layered hair with a long curtain fringe the eyes peek through, wispy flyaways, longer at the back of the neck; emo / alt teens and young adults — takes any hairCol

shaggymulletpink.note: the same cut in its original pastel pink-lavender (fixed colour, hairCol is ignored)

overshoulder.note: very long hair with a centre part, face fully clear, brushed over one shoulder to the waist in front and down the back; teens / adults — takes any hairCol

overshoulderrose.note: the same cut in its original rose-blonde with darker roots (fixed colour, hairCol is ignored)
